2- **The Mere Exposure Effect** is a powerful psychological insight explaining our tendency to **develop a preference for things simply because we are familiar with them.** 👀📈💖 The more often we're exposed to a person, idea, or object, the more we tend to like it – even without conscious awareness! Understanding this is incredibly useful: it sheds light on why popular songs get stuck in our heads, how advertising works, and why familiarity can breed liking in social interactions. It encourages us to leverage repeated, positive exposure in areas we want to grow or connect! 💡🔄

(Morgh-e bāgh-e malakūt-īm, az īn dām-gah-e khāk bar khīzīm)
(We are birds of the celestial garden, let us rise from this earthly cage.)
**Poet:** Rumi (مولانا جلال‌الدین محمد بلخی) - the revered 13th-century Persian poet and Sufi mystic, whose profound verses often explore themes of the soul's divine origin and its yearning to return to its spiritual home. This beautiful line encourages us to transcend worldly limitations and seek our higher self. 📜🌟
